invariants: The public GitHub Pages command center remains OBSERVE-only and contains no operator controls.
Only the repository owner may run the operator workflow.
Status and evidence reports contain sanitized state only.
Workflow reruns are restricted to an explicit allowlist.
Queue cancellation requires an exact SWORK identifier and a quiescent scheduler.
Emergency stop cancels currently queued/in-progress managed autonomous runs but does not silently rewrite persistent policy.
Pause, resume, budget, and approval persistence are proposed through a pull request; main is never directly modified by those operations.
The operator console cannot send customer communications, move money, place trades, change secrets, or disclose private payloads.
